pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
A Pale Garden-themed ranged weapon.

• Keeps all vanilla bow mechanics: charge to shoot, enchantable (Power, Flame, Punch, Infinity, etc.)
• Durability 1536 (four times the vanilla bow's 384)
• Uses any arrow as ammo

Vulnerability effect
• Arrow hits apply Vulnerability: +50% damage taken for 5s
• Works for both the owner and dolls
• Repeated hits only refresh the duration, do not stack the multiplier
• If the target is frozen by a Pale Doll's Fear Aura, the two vulnerabilities stack for +100% damage taken in total

pages.title: Pale Doll Bonus
pages.text:
When a Pale Doll uses the Pale Bow, it gets the following bonuses:

• No ammo needed: can draw and shoot directly, consuming no ammunition
• Faster charge: draws to full more quickly
• Faster arrows: fired arrows fly faster

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text: 3 resin bricks + 3 string in a zigzag layout. Resin bricks are smelted from resin blocks found in the Pale Garden.
